notes: two «ح» branches: the first ends at عبد الله بن المبارك after «ح»; the second's «جميعا عن هشام» writes the names after it once, so هشام, محمد and أبو هريرة are the shared tail
«وفي رواية أبي بكر قال نهى رسول الله» is a wording variant of the same transmitter, left out
«محمد» is written bare in the text; it is kept as written (the archive's lexicon would decide which Muhammad), no full name is supplied
